initialSurface: Current SQLConsole offers no result export/copy control. No missing-feature issue filed. Recovery logical database export was not exercised.

Availability observation timeouts were not terminal failures. Exact owned physical state later showed core Ready, ExtensionsReady and applied application database before the read-only checks.
limits: No assistive-technology audio, dark mode or Chinese locale tested

request.query:
mutation CreateDatabase($name: String!, $databaseName: String, $databaseUser: String, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $plan: String, $version: String, $diskSizeGB: Int, $public: Boolean) {
  createDatabase(
    name: $name
    databaseName: $databaseName
    databaseUser: $databaseUser
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    plan: $plan
    version: $version
    diskSizeGB: $diskSizeGB
    public: $public
  ) {
    id
    name
    databaseName
    databaseUser
    plan
    status
    projectId
    environmentId
    __typename
  }
}

SELECT n AS ordinal,
       CASE n % 5 WHEN 1 THEN NULL::text WHEN 2 THEN 'NULL' WHEN 3 THEN 'null' WHEN 4 THEN '' ELSE '雪 café' END AS value,
       E'quoted "a,b"\n雪𝒜' AS note,
       9223372036854775000::bigint + n AS exact_integer
FROM generate_series(1,55) AS series(n)
ORDER BY n;
